item: The next two demo screens ("type a goal, get a campaign" and "photo or spreadsheet to patient list") need AI. Real AI means a paid Anthropic API account (pay per use) and a small server. Use real AI now, or labelled sample drafts first?
recommendation: Sample drafts first, clearly labelled, at no cost. The spreadsheet import works for real without AI. Get the API account once one clinic says yes. The demo link is private: share it from its Share menu if anyone else should open it

item: Create a Semaphore account and share an API key
recommendation: Prepaid credits only; no real sends until the pilot clinic approves

item: Book 3 dental or vet clinic meetings for the prototype demo
recommendation: Target the week after the prototype ships

item: Register the business (DTI) and send one email to DTI Pampanga on free events and announcements

Legal check: dental testimonials, texting a family number about a dependent (DPA s.13), including whether even a generic "a visit is due" is too revealing, keeping an opt-out after an erasure request, showing a clinic name that names a treatment ("Smile Implant Center") in texts, whether the frozen sensitive word list is enough (names like Lasik or Thyroid still pass), and how long the send log may keep a dependent's visit date and service after the dependent's record is deleted (G49)
recommendation: One consult covers all six. Until then: testimonials off for dental, texts about dependents name nothing (not even cleaning or check-up, nor a clinic name that names a treatment), erased opt-outs are kept, a treatment-naming clinic name goes out only after the clinic confirms it and only in texts about the patient or their pet, the word list stays frozen, and the send log keeps a deleted dependent's visit date and service only for the clinic's audit period, then clears them
Revisit is a placeholder. Pick a global, non-Filipino brand before the first clinic demo; Claude can shortlist names with free .com domains
